verdict.rationale: The repeated pattern is to favor the operationally cleaner hotel when morning site access matters, while explicitly verifying coffee/mini-fridge details before commitment when the room page is incomplete. Marshside is tied on rating and otherwise comparable, while improving both the new-gate drive and rate. Its missing refrigerator language is a verification gap rather than a reason to discard it; River Market should remain the ready fallback because its king-room amenities are already documented.
